title: fix(fields): a person picked in a list cell shows their name at once; avatar initials are letters only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_

Fixes #36046

repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oY5WCqqqBMtn9qt7m

Clause-②: no — measured on the built `@object-ui/fields` declarations; reading under Verification
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里在「负责人」这类人员格子中选人后,格子立刻显示这个人的名字和头像,不再先显示一串用户编号、等列表重新加载才变成名字;头像里的缩写只取字母,例如「Alice (Sales)」显示 AS,不再是 A( 。
- 属于列表单元格编辑体验那一组改进,替在列表里直接改负责人的用户解决「选完人看到一串编号」的困惑。
- 出错时最坏是选人后格子仍显示编号(改前的样子),保存的数据不受影响;单字名的缩写从一个字母变成两个字母(如 Ada 显示 AD),和人员选择器里的一致;可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

**Item 1 — a pick shows the name at once.** A `user` cell's edit stores the picked person's id, and the save answers the id too, while `UserCellRenderer` draws a person only from the expanded record a list read brings — so the cell drew the raw id (the unresolved-reference mark) from the pick until the list was read again. Measured on the base: the grid pin below, run with the pick keeping nothing, draws `u36046_bob` both while the save is on the wire and after it landed.

- The reference-record cache the lookup cell already reads (`useLookupName`'s module-level record + schema cache) moves, unchanged in shape and key, into its own React-free module `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/referenceRecordCache.ts`, so the picker and the cell renderers share it without an import cycle. No second cache.
- `LookupField` (the editor behind every `user` / `lookup` cell, the in-cell `PeoplePicker` included) keeps the records a pick hands back in that cache (`rememberPickedRecords`) on each pick path: the in-cell list / popover pick, the Level-2 pickers' `onSelectRecords`, and the browse-all dialog's single pick.
- `UserCellRenderer` draws a stored id (scalar, or each entry of a multi-value array) as the person the cache holds for it (`heldReferenceRecord`, reads nothing), then everything below runs as for an expanded value (field-level security via `withoutDeniedFields`, the name ladder, the face). An id nothing holds is still the objectui#8434 unresolved reference.
- A lookup cell whose column names no display field reads the same cache entry, so it also shows a picked record's name without its `findOne` read.

**Item 2 — initials are letters only.** `getPersonInitials` (people-field chips, `PersonRow`, the comment author avatar) splits words on anything that is not a letter (combining marks stay with their letter): `Alice (Sales)` → `AS`, `(Bob)` → `BO`, `A.` → `A`, `()` → `?`; the CJK given-name rule is kept. The person cell's two inline copies and `AvatarField`'s `getInitials` copy now call it instead.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.peoplePickName-36046.test.tsx` (new): a select-first `ObjectGrid` with a `user` column; select the cell, Enter, pick a person in the in-cell people picker. The data source answers no later list read and no `findOne`. (1) while the write never answers: the cell shows `Bob Wu (Sales)`, no id, no unresolved mark, initials `BS`; (2) once the write answers the id: still the name, no list read, no person read.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/userCell.pickedRecord-36046.test.tsx` (new): the cell draws a picked id's person (single and multi), keeps an unheld id unresolved (control), and draws letters-only initials.
- `personDisplay.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` for letters-only initials (brackets, punctuation, digits, one-letter fallback, `?`, CJK, every result matches `^\p{L}{1,2}$`).

## Acceptance notes

- Visible side effects of sharing one initials function: the person cell and the `avatar` widget now draw a single-word name's first two letters (`Ada` → `AD`, the `avatar` widget's `User` placeholder → `US`) and a CJK name's given-name characters, as the people chips and picker rows already did. The card's suggested `(Bob)` ⇒ `B` reads `BO` for the same reason; `A.` ⇒ `A` is the one-letter fallback.
- Same-family copies outside the people cell keep their own naive initials (a bracket can still be an initial there): `ownerInitials` in `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` (`KanbanCardOwner.ts`), `initialsFromName` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`HistoryTimeline.tsx`), `getUserInitials` in `@object-ui/auth`, and the stack in `@object-ui/collaboration` (`PresenceAvatars.tsx`). Reported to the seat as one family, not filed here.
- The pick-kept record lives in the module-wide cache for the page's life, as fetched lookup records already do; a list read's expanded value always wins over it, since the cache is consulted only for a stored id.

## Verification

Two-minute check: in the console's list of any object with a `user` field (showcase), select the owner cell, press Enter, pick a person — the cell shows their name and face immediately, before the list reloads.

Files to read first, by risk: `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (the `UserCellRenderer` hunk that resolves a stored id), `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` (the three `rememberPickedRecords` calls), `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/personDisplay.ts`.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 64028f37)</summary>

- New and neighbouring pins, 15 files, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 …` from `ui/`: `Test Files 15 passed (15) · Tests 146 passed (146)` (both new files, `personDisplay.test.ts`, the three existing `userCell.*` files, `lookupCellDisplayField`, `UserFieldPicker`, `PeoplePicker`, `inCellFaces-35688`, `fileRestrictedState-12339`, `AvatarField.fileId-10785`, `inlineEditLookupRepro`, `lookupRestrictedRecord-13335`, plugin-detail `commentSmallFixes-36070`).
- `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/fields` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid`: exit 0 each.
- eslint over the eight changed source and test files: 0 errors.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 39): 37 run, exit 0; `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (prerequisite not met: its closure build never got a turn on the verify lock) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` not run, both left to CI.
- Narrowing declared: the shared verify lock gave no turn in over an hour, so the runs above went unlocked at one worker; the full `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` suites are CI's (Test UI, Type Check UI).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (head 64028f37, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

- A pick keeps nothing (`rememberPickedRecords` returns at once; the base's behaviour): 4 failed of the 6 in the two new cell/grid files — the grid cell reads `u36046_bob` while the save is on the wire and after it landed; the two control-shaped cases stay green.
- Initials split on spaces only (the base's word rule): 3 failed (`Mary O'Brien` gives `MO`, `()` gives an empty string, the letters-only sweep); the bracket case stays green because each word's initial is still read as its first letter.

</details>
